metric_deltas_m3gl_minus_m3gj.interpretation: M3GL is a regression, not promotion noise. It used the same 7-label high-signal region-grid manifests, same region-preserving TCN family, and same input contract, but a new seed shifted class bias and reduced held-out test performance.

m3gj_current_m3gb_baseline.notable_pattern: M3GJ/M3GB current outputs overpredict sad on test and leave black, please, table, and white at zero test recall.

m3gl.notable_pattern: M3GL shifts from the M3GB/M3GJ sad-heavy test bias to table-heavy test predictions. Table improves to 0.5 recall on validation and test, but sad collapses from 1.0 test recall in M3GJ to 0.0 in M3GL, and hello/please are never predicted on test.

joined_clip_change_counts.interpretation: The same validation/test clips produce substantially different predictions between the two seeds, which points to unstable class-boundary learning under the current dataset/vocabulary/input contract rather than a single deterministic evaluator-accounting issue.

signer_patterns_m3gl.interpretation: Signer/split effects remain plausible, but rows per signer are small and do not prove signer causality without a contract that separates signer coverage, source capture, and vocabulary composition.
